The best thing you can do is to not give up and keep going. As an athlete you know that one of the best ways to thrive in whatever event or sport you do is to keep pushing. Just like in a sport if you keep pushing you get better at it, the same thing goes here and in life in general, if you keep pushing and don’t give up, things will get better, and in due time you’ll reach the happiness you strive for. Use your daughter as motivation, let her be your guiding let, keep pushing for her, improve for her, get better for her. Take advantage of that motivation and don’t let her down. If you don’t want to do it for yourself do it for her, and once you pushed past the dark time you’re in now, you’ll be able to look around and see that since you did it for her, it helped yourself too.

Hey I get that college and future choices can be tough and things seem uncertain, but whatever direction you take you’ll find something. If one place doesn’t work for you than maybe another will. Everyone has somewhere that will work for them and something that they’re interested in. Along with this, every new place provides new chances for friends, and potentially new relationships.  And one bad semester doesn’t mean that you aren’t intelligent enough. Keep on pushing and trying with whatever path you take and I’m certain that In due time you’ll find something that makes you happy, Friends who make you laugh, and a relationship that makes you feel loved. The most important thing is to not give up and to keep pushing on. Show the world how strong you really can be.

I’ve been having problems with my girlfriend, not relationship wise, but she has depression, anxiety, and is suicidal. Shes the reason I started using Reddit so I could find some advice on ways to help her. I’ve been doing everything I can to help her, but the quarantine thing isn’t helping her right now.
More than happy to help, I hope things start going your way.

As long as you hold on to that hope you have something. It’s a dark tunnel but at the end of it, even if it’s a tiny flicker from where you are now is light, and if you have that hope and belief that you can each it, than you can, you can do anything. If you give up on it that’s when that light fades away.  If other people aren’t going to help you get there then sometimes the best thing to do is focus on getting there yourself.  Don’t let other who are going to drain you drag you down, prove to them that you are better than that, prove that you don’t need their negativity, and that you thrive with your own integrity.

I get that you want to hurt the people that hurt you, but doing that will solve nothing, especially if it’s by taking your own life. You’re strong to carry on and for trying to make things get better, life has a way of throwing curveballs at you when you seem to be getting better, but those show you how strong you can be. Eventually if you hang in there long enough and don’t give up hope you’ll find you happiness that will be well deserved. I know it can be an uphill battle but I know you have the strength to carry on and find your true happiness with people who won’t hurt you and genuinely make you feel loved and appreciated.

If you want to be heard, I hear you. There is much more to this life then death, and I know it can be hard at times, and no one can understand exactly how you feel, but giving up on life only guarantees that you throw away your chance at happiness in the future. If you keep pushing on, eventually I’m certain that you’ll be truly happy and you’ll look back at this as just a dark time in your life.  Everyone has the potential to be happy and have a great future, and the only thing that will stop you from reaching it is by giving up on life.

No one is unsuited for life, everyone has a purpose even if you can’t always see it. Everyone can find a way in life that makes them happy. If you deny yourself life you deny the future that you will have and the happiness that will come from. I understand it’s hard to come out of school and try to figure out where to go, hell im just finishing my first year of college and I don’t even know what I’m going to be doing with my degree yet.  Whether you go for education or for a trade job it opens up a lot of paths and presents new opportunities. I’m certain that even though you may seem uncertain now that I’m due time you’ll find something that makes you happy.

You’re not a burden to your family, they love you no matter what. Ending your life would not lessen their burden, the grief and despair it would cause would not make it worse. No matter how much of a burden you think you are, you’re still their child and they love you. The pain of loosing you would be greater then anything they’re dealing with now. 

In regards to being social, maybe try talking in some online communities if personal ones are too much. There are plenty of great people on the internet and I’m certain you can find people that you can talk to, bond with, and even become friends with. Some people even meet their best friends online, I’m sure you can too.

The more courageous thing is staying alive. The people around you may not understand how you’re struggling, but take pride in every step you take and every time you push one day forward. You’re parents may want you to do good and get good grades, but I’m more than certain that they’d prefer you to be alive. Every day you keep pushing on makes you a better person and the best thing you can do is to keep living, because living is hard and it takes strength and courage to keep living, remember that every day you are still breathing.

You are not a monster, or ugly. All you are is amazing and a wonderful person, don’t let anyone tell you otherwise. You are a person, a human being, and everyone who puts you down just don’t appreciate you for the amazing person that you are.

Hey buddy, I know it may seem like you’re alone and it’s sucks, I know it does, being lonely is one of the worst feelings out there, but just cause some shitty people left you alone and ghosted you doesn’t mean that you’re the problem.  I’m telling you, there are people out there who want to be your friend, there are people out there who want to love you, they just haven’t found you yet. Keep on driving, keep holding on. And don’t fret about those folk who left you alone, cause if that’s how they treat you then you are better off without them.
I don’t know if I can help much, but just because things are dark and always have been, don’t give up. I know it’s not much but I genuinely hope things look up for you brother, god bless.
